event_chain.summary: Director falls for phishing email impersonating Bithumb
Stolen Safe owner keys used to upgrade bridge contract

summary: On June 5, 2026 a Humanity Protocol director opened a phishing email impersonating Bithumb and downloaded a malicious archive whose signed loader gave North Korean attackers remote control of his laptop. The attackers copied his MetaMask wallet and private keys, which held three of six owner keys of the Gnosis Safe controlling the Hyperlane bridge ProxyAdmin. On June 8 they took over the ProxyAdmin, pushed a malicious contract upgrade and drained about 141.2 million H tokens on Ethereum, and on BNB Chain minted additional H, stealing about 193.6 million H in total worth roughly $36 million. Quantstamp attributed the attack to DPRK actors.
